invented_claims.claim: QA Lead is responsible for test plan execution and reporting
QA Engineers create and execute test cases and automation
Developers write unit tests and fix defects
Security Team performs security reviews and penetration tests
Release Manager coordinates deployments to QA/UAT/Staging
Test management will use Azure DevOps or Jira
API testing tooling includes Postman, Newman, or REST-assured
UI automation will prefer Playwright (or Selenium)
Backend SQL verification will use pytest with Databricks connectors or Databricks notebooks
Performance/load testing will use Locust or JMeter
AI validation tooling will use custom Python scripts to compute metrics
Blob storage access controls will restrict agreement access to permitted roles
Data-at-rest and in-transit encryption must be verified
Access to confidential data must be logged and auditable
Entry criteria include dev unit tests passed, QA environment provisioned, golden dataset loaded, AI services accessible

references: Explicit listing / links to the BRD and the Rebate Claim Validation architecture diagram referenced in the BRD
Reference versioning and document locations (where reviewers can find the BRD/diagram)
security_compliance: Explicit tests for MFA, session timeout and JWT/token validation (refresh/expiry) called out
CSRF and XSS specific test cases and input-validation fuzzing
Explicit verification that spend data is not written to logs (sensitive data redaction tests)
Clear SAST/DAST test plan (only a basic pentest/dependency scan is referenced)
nfr_reliability: Explicit backup & restore tests and validation of restore correctness
Documented runbooks / incident response test cases (exercise runbooks)
Explicit end-to-end recovery and data-reconciliation tests after restore (beyond retries)
nfr_accessibility_compat: Detailed accessibility test cases: screen reader labels, keyboard-only navigation, focus order and ARIA attributes
Colour contrast, error identification and zoom/reflow test cases
Explicit supported-browser matrix and compatibility test cases (Edge/Chrome/Firefox versions)
